item.title: King’s baton's PNG journey: from Government house to completion
item.description: The Papua New Guinea Commonwealth Games Association (PNG CGA) successfully completed its leg of the King's Baton Relay today, combining Commonwealth ceremonial tradition with indigenous cultural celebrations and environmental conservation efforts across two provinces.

item.title: Solomon Kings edge 10-man Hekari FC in OFC Pro League opener.
item.description: The final two teams to make their competition bow, both coaches were determined to make up for the wait and lay down an early marker in Round 1.

item.title: Flickering lights, fixed: Poreporena Freeway now safe
item.description: For months, malfunctioning streetlights on the Burns Peak section of the Poreporena Freeway in Port Moresby turned what should have been a safe passage into a hazardous "disco" of unpredictable flashes.

item.title: Broncos secure dominant victory in championship opener; Alex Max nets double
item.description: The New Look London Broncos kicked off their 2026 campaign with a commanding 44–12 victory over Widnes Vikings in their Betfred Championship opener.

item.title: School boys' consumption of illicit alcohol a growing concern
item.description: A worried mother from Hiri Koiari District in Central Province has voiced her concerns over the increasing involvement of male students in illicit alcohol consumption during school holidays.

item.title: No fees, no collection, no Teachers Day gifts
item.description: Schools are resuming. This week, teachers return to the classrooms. Next week, students will start school with brand new uniforms, new socks, shoes, school bags, and stationery.

item.title: PNGRFL Officials, Digicel Exxon Mobil Cup coaches arrive in Daru to scout Fly River Cup talent
item.description: Officials from the PNG Rugby Football League (PNGRFL) and Digicel Exxon Mobil Cup franchise coaches have arrived in Daru, Western Province, to observe and scout talent at the Fly River Cup Tournament, which kicks off on Wednesday, January 21, 2026.
